Workshop outputs (bulleted, rough):
- Baseline traffic: steady-state 40 QPS for chat traffic (user-facing), average request: 350-500 tokens in/out (input ~150, output ~250).
- Baseline tokens/sec calc: 40 QPS * 450 avg tokens/request => ~18,000 tokens/sec steady-state.
- Peak planning: expected burst pattern up to 120 QPS during promotional events (3x steady) => ~54,000 tokens/sec peak for ~10-20 min bursts.
- Reranking pipeline: async batch jobs 8 concurrent workers, average 12 candidates, 120 reqs/min => modest background throughput but sensitive to latency for batch windows.
